questions.question: What is the density of $X\sim\operatorname{Exp}(\lambda)$?
questions.explanation: For $X\sim\operatorname{Exp}(\lambda)$, the density is $f_X(x)=\lambda e^{-\lambda x}$ on the support $x\ge0$ (and $0$ otherwise).
questions.source_support: The definition gives $f_X(x)=\lambda e^{-\lambda x}$ for $x\ge0$.

$x/\lambda^2$ over all reals is not a valid density; it mixes up the Rayleigh form with the exponential.
